scientific_integrity: Analytical proof is provided, with finite diagnostics as checks only. No third-party publication or independent mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only standard unit-edge complete-bipartite graphical zonotopes; weak limits and lower-edge asymptotics, not finite-dimensional density formulas. Exact first/second directional-width moments are previously published and explicitly credited. The balanced one-sample Gaussian Gini connection is prior statistical context; the comparison of full bipartite aspect-ratio and fixed-side angular regimes carries a residual risk of equivalent statements in broad two-sample theory.
title: Sparse-part angular-width laws for complete-bipartite graphical zonotopes
